item.title: Starstruck
item.description:
What a Day

April 8 2024 is ingrained, burnt into my eyes. Witnessing a solar eclipse is easily one of the best experiences I have had

2 years on, I was looking back at my photos and came across this oldie but goodie.

Every time I look at it, it makes me smile.

item.title: The Old King's Crown
item.description:
Description

Out-manoeuvre your rivals as you vie for control of an ancient, crumbling kingdom.

First Played

Date: 2026-04-25

Player Number: 4

First Impressions

Great game. I played very conservatively but I loved how meaty the action gets and how interactive it is. I am more curious about learning the strategy than winning at this.
